verdicts.reason: A is broken. The dark header bar stops at the left half of the canvas, leaving the right half empty. The orange divider floats alone on the right, separated from the headline it belongs under. The legal line has drifted to the lower right, so the layout looks lopsided and accidental. B keeps the original's centered structure, colours and logo, and its wider 3-line headline suits the format. However, the content is packed into the top two-thirds with a dead band above the legal line. The header bar and logo are slightly squeezed, and the legal text is very small.
